name: Engram Vault Sync
description: Your notes are your AI's memory. Sync your vault everywhere, search by meaning, and let Claude, Cursor, and other AI apps read and write your notes. Hosted or self-host, free to start. 让 Claude、Cursor 等 AI 读写你的 Obsidian 笔记，多设备同步，语义搜索，支持自托管。Claude や Cursor などの AI がノートを読み書き。全デバイス同期、セマンティック検索、セルフホスト対応。
author: Rasbandit
